name: Securities Financing Status Advice V 11
definition: Scope|An securities financing transaction account servicer sends a SecuritiesFinancingStatusAdvice to an account owner to advise the status of a securities financing transaction previously instructed by the account owner.|The status advice may be sent as a response to the request of the account owner or not.|The account servicer/owner relationship may be:|- a central securities depository or another settlement market infrastructure managing securities financing transactions on behalf of their participants|- an agent (sub-custodian) managing securities financing transactions on behalf of their global custodian customer, or|- a custodian managing securities financing transactions on behalf of an investment management institution or a broker/dealer.||Usage|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message previously sent,|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information,|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information using the relevant elements in the Business Application Header.

MatchingStatus.name: Matching Status
MatchingStatus.definition: Provides the matching status of the instruction.

InferredMatchingStatus.name: Inferred Matching Status
InferredMatchingStatus.definition: Provides the matching status of an instruction as per the account servicer based on an allegement. At this time no matching took place on the market (at the Central Securities Depository (CSD)/International Central Securities Depository (ICSD)).

SettlementStatus.name: Settlement Status
SettlementStatus.definition: Provides the status of settlement of a transaction.

RepoCallRequestStatus.name: Repo Call Request Status
RepoCallRequestStatus.definition: Provides the status of the repurchase agreement call request.

TransactionDetails.name: Transaction Details
TransactionDetails.definition: Identifies the details of the transaction.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

SettlementStatusAndMatchedRule.definition: If SettlementStatus is present alone, then it means that the transaction is matched (if a matching process exists in the concerned market or at the concerned account servicer).
